//: ETicketsGo API (NestJS + Prisma). Railway service Root Directory MUST stay '/' — the Dockerfile builds from the monorepo root and COPYs package manifests from apps/* and packages/*. Set this file as the service's config-as-code path (Settings -> Config-as-code -> deploy/railway/api.railway.json). MIGRATIONS: preDeployCommand runs ONCE per deployment, before any new replica receives traffic, and a non-zero exit FAILS the deploy — this is the single migration executor for the environment; worker and web services must never run migrations. The image WORKDIR is /app/apps/api, so 'npx prisma migrate deploy' resolves prisma/schema.prisma and 'node dist/main.js' resolves the compiled API. PORT is injected by Railway and honoured ahead of API_PORT (apps/api/src/main.ts binds 0.0.0.0:PORT). numReplicas is 1 for QA/UAT; raise to >=2 in Production (see docs/deployment/RAILWAY_COST_SIZING.md).
